Thanks again for the demo last week — LedgerCorp is excited about the low-latency routing for payment status enrichment. Procurement is running a tight timeline for our vendor onboarding and they need some privacy evidence before we can move to a PoC:

- DPIA / data flow mapping that shows what personal data is sent to Redwood during enrichment, where it flows (including any third-party subprocessors), and retention windows.

- Any cross-border transfer mechanisms you rely on (SCCs, BCRs, or adequacy decisions) for US-to-EU transfers, and whether additional safeguards are applied for payments data.

Can you share a single packet (PDFs or Drive link) we can attach to our vendor file? Procurement would like these by EOD Tuesday 25 May to keep the SOW timeline.

- DPA redlines: I've attached a marked DPA PDF with our suggested compromise around audit frequency and scope (we propose annual remote evidence + one possible on-site during contract year with 60 days' notice).

Michael — hi, Grace from Security here. A couple of clarifications on the technical controls included in the packet:

- Cross-border transfers: We use EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for transfers and a documented safeguard matrix for additional protections (encryption in transit/rest, dedicated VPC options on Dedicated/Private plans, and dual-key KMS for customers that require separate control).
- Subprocessors: The dataflow diagram highlights third-party subprocessors used for metrics/observability and cloud infra; we can provide a time-stamped subprocessor register export and attest to notification practices for new subprocessors.
- Logging & retention: Payment enrichment traces are retained for up to 30 days by default in ephemeral logs; aggregated observability metrics are retained 90 days. If LedgerCorp needs extended retention for audit purposes we can discuss an SLA addendum.

For PCI scope: our platform does not process raw cardholder data for enrichment — we enrich with tokenized identifiers provided by LedgerCorp. If you require PCI artifacts we will need to confirm scope and potentially involve our infra partner for a separate attestation.

I propose a quick call to confirm the exact audit scope before scheduling. Ben — can you propose 30-min slots tomorrow?

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
